newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi to begin cold storage business in India.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi to begin cold storage business in India.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp said on Tuesday it will set up a joint company in India with Mitsubishi Warehouse and Transportation Co Ltd and two local companies, to develop the first cold storage chain in the country.
The new company, Snowman Frozen Foods Ltd, will be capitalised at 1.18 million Indian rupees, and business is expected to start in the beginning of 1997, Mitsubishi Corp said in a statement.
The venture will be 51 percent owned by Amalgam Foods Ltd of India, 26 percent by Mitsubishi Corp, 15 percent by Brooke Bond Lipton India Ltd, and eight percent by Mitsubishi Warehouse.

Mitsubishi Corp said Snowman will install cold storage houses in 10 Indian cities, including New Delhi and Bombay, for storage and transportation of frozen foods, such as seafood, vegetables and dairy products. The company also expects to produce and market processed foods, Mitsubishi said.
